name: czrecoil_frame_on_menu_start_single_player
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuStartSinglePlayer clears intro and mission FMV skip flags and starts the engine through the global RecoilApp.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x430740 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
Binary Ninja shows the void command handler ends as a direct jump to RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndStartEngine, which HLIL renders as a tailcall return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x430740 validates writes of zero to g_RecoilApp.m_skipIntroFmv and g_RecoilApp.m_missionFmvState.m_skipMissionFmv before the direct jump to RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndStartEngine.
The dependency frontier for 0x430740 has no visible source blockers; RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndStartEngine is already functional and binary accepted.
The native smoke initializes the global RecoilApp engine-start harness, calls CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuStartSinglePlayer, and verifies both skip flags plus the engine-start side effects.
